title: NADPH exerts neuroprotection in ischemic stroke by reinforcing blood-brain barrier integrity and stimulating angiogenesis.
authors: Xu, Hui; Zhang, Hua; Shi, Rui-Rui; Ge, Jian-Bin; Wu, Feng; Qin, Zheng-Hong; Gu, Jin-Hua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究NADPH在缺血性卒中中的神经保护作用，聚焦血脑屏障完整性与血管生成，虽含分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ischemic stroke (IS) represents a significant global health burden with increasing incidence, creating an urgent need for novel therapeutic approaches. This study explored the neuroprotective effects of nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NADPH) in preserving blood-brain barrier (BBB) integrity and promoting angiogenesis after IS. Through network pharmacology analysis and molecular docking, five key molecular targets of NADPH in IS were identified: HIF-1alpha, SRC, NLRP3, CASP3, and AKT1. In vivo, NADPH treatment conferred significant protection against cerebral ischemia in the transient middle cerebral artery occlusion (tMCAO) model. At the optimal dose of 7.5 mg/kg, it substantially reduced infarct volume ( approximately 50%), attenuated cerebral edema (from 81% to 76%), improved neurological function ( approximately 58%), and preserved BBB integrity. Mechanistically, NADPH protected the BBB by upregulating key tight junction (TJ) proteins, including a  approximately 29% increase in ZO-1 expression, with electron microscopy confirming strengthened TJ structure. NADPH also reduced the protein levels of matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP9) and caveolin-1 by  approximately 23% and 50%, respectively. Furthermore, it suppressed NLRP3 inflammasome activation, decreased the expression of NLRP3 ( approximately 14%), ASC ( approximately 24%), Caspase-1 ( approximately 30%), and interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta;  approximately 16%), thereby attenuating inflammation. In vitro, NADPH enhanced endothelial cell proliferation, migration, and tube formation under oxygen-glucose deprivation (OGD) conditions. Additionally, NADPH further elevated the expression of key pro-angiogenic markers, increasing HIF-1alpha protein by  approximately 77.1% and vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) by  approximately 44.8% at day 7 post-tMCAO. These findings suggest that NADPH confers neuroprotection in IS by preserving BBB integrity, inhibiting NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated damage, and stimulating angiogenesis through HIF-1alpha/VEGF signaling. Our results highlight NADPH's dual therapeutic mechanisms and its potential as a promising neuroprotective agent for IS.
abstract_zh: 缺血性卒中（Ischemic stroke, IS）构成重大全球健康负担，且发病率不断上升，亟需新型治疗策略。本研究探讨了烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸磷酸（NADPH）在缺血性卒中后保护血脑屏障（BBB）完整性及促进血管生成中的神经保护作用。通过网络药理学分析和分子对接，确定了NADPH在IS中的五个关键分子靶点：HIF-1α、SRC、NLRP3、CASP3和AKT1。在体内实验中，NADPH治疗在短暂大脑中动脉闭塞（tMCAO）模型中对脑缺血提供了显著保护。在最佳剂量7.5 mg/kg下，它大幅减少了梗死体积（约50%），减轻了脑水肿（从81%降至76%），改善了神经功能（约58%），并维持了BBB完整性。机制上，NADPH通过上调关键紧密连接（TJ）蛋白来保护BBB，包括ZO-1表达增加约29%，电子显微镜证实了TJ结构的增强。NADPH还使基质金属蛋白酶-9（MMP9）和caveolin-1的蛋白水平分别降低约23%和50%。此外，它抑制了NLRP3炎症小体激活，降低了NLRP3（约14%）、ASC（约24%）、Caspase-1（约30%）和白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β；约16%）的表达，从而减轻炎症。在体外实验中，NADPH在氧糖剥夺（OGD）条件下增强了内皮细胞增殖、迁移和管形成能力。此外，NADPH进一步提升了关键促血管生成标志物的表达，在tMCAO后第7天使HIF-1α蛋白增加约77.1%，血管内皮生长因子（VEGF）增加约44.8%。这些发现表明，NADPH通过维持BBB完整性、抑制NLRP3炎症小体介导的损伤以及通过HIF-1α/VEGF信号刺激血管生成，在IS中发挥神经保护作用。我们的结果凸显了NADPH的双重治疗机制及其作为IS有前景的神经保护剂的潜力。
